mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.id id, r.name name FROM ums_user u INNER JOIN ums_user_role_relation uurr on u.id = uurr.user_id INNER JOIN ums_role role on uurr.role_id = role.id INNER JOIN ums_role_resource_relation urrr on uurr.role_id = urrr.role_id INNER JOIN ums_resource r on urrr.resource_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT re.* FROM ums_role r INNER JOIN ums_role_resource_relation rrr on r.id = rrr.role_id INNER JOIN ums_resource re on rrr.resource_id = re.id WHERE r.id = #{roleId}
